svg.title: Md. Foisal, Full-Stack Developer and Product Engineer
svg.desc: Hey, I'm Foisal. Full-Stack Developer / Product Engineer · from schema to screen / Database Architecture & Domain-Driven Design / UI Architecture · Livewire · Vue · React · Next.js. Open to remote work. Thinks like a product manager, designs like an architect and ships like a developer, from first idea to production. Skills: PHP, Laravel, Livewire, Filament, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
